svg.title: Knowledge Store contexts and slices
svg.desc: Knowledge Store's eight bounded contexts in core, supporting and generic subdomain bands, each with its feature slices, the ports it owns, their adapters and the services it runs in, with the applications that use it above and how the contexts meet below.
svg.text: Knowledge Store: subdomains, bounded contexts and feature slices (target)
Each box is a bounded context: one module with its own model, contract and stores. Inside it, feature slices sit over a pure domain core; ports appear only where an adapter varies.
All contexts run in a few services by default (ADR-044). A context gets a service of its own only on a trigger; Extraction's model-heavy batch work is the first.
USED BY (each brings adapters, an ontology, tools and a question set through the contracts)
CORE SUBDOMAINS: where Knowledge Store is different
none of its own: it uses Platform services' contract
runs in: the sweep, the CLI
none of its own: it uses Platform services' contract
runs in: graph and passage tools, the sweep
runs in: portal API, chat page, interceptor
GENERIC SUBDOMAIN: bought or shared, every context uses it
runs in: the CLI; a library in every image
Ingestion supplies passages and tables to Extraction (customer and supplier); the lake layout is the contract.
Ontology publishes each released version as a published language that Extraction, Knowledge Graph and Answering conform to.
Extraction supplies SHACL-valid facts to Knowledge Graph, which keeps them as the record and opens its read tools as an open host service to Answering.
Evaluation is downstream of Answering and Knowledge Graph, and shares the ClaimVerifier with Answering, so the eval measures what production enforces.
Access holds who may ask and read what; Answering and Knowledge Graph filter by the scope it supplies. Platform services is used by every context through its contract.
proposed feature with a UI (a pn- element)

Decisions: ADR-024 (the kit), ADR-046 (contexts, slices and ports), ADR-047 (knowledge contexts on Knowledge Store), ADR-048 (the evaluation framework). Contexts are BC-001 to BC-008 in knowledge-store's architecture pages.
